sentences.text: Indore, Dated: 01/08/2018 Shri Vibhor Khandelwal, Public Prosecutor for the applicant/State.

This is an application under Section 378 (3) (4) of Criminal Procedure Code seeking leave to file appeal against the judgment dated 11/7/2017 passed by the JMFC, Dhar in Criminal Case No.
346/2007.

It is submitted by the counsel for the applicant that on the basis of the evidence which has come on record, it is incorrect to say that the vendor is entitled for protection under Section 19 (2) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954.

Considering the submissions made by the counsel for the applicant and after going through the record of the Court below, this Court is of the considered opinion that it is a fit case for grant of leave to file appeal against the judgment dated 11/7/2017 passed by the JMFC, Dhar in Criminal Case No.
346/2007.
The Office is directed to register the criminal appeal separately.
This MCRC is finally disposed of.

(G.S.Ahluwalia)
AKS Judge The State Of Madhya Pradesh vs Heeralal Devnani on 1 August, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/145861962/
